caseName: Superintendent of Insurance v. Bankers Life & Casualty Co.
caseNameFull: Superintendent of Insurance of New York v. Bankers Life & Casualty Co.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 401 U. S. 973.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to permit the Securities and Exchange Commission to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae in support of petitioner granted, and 15 minutes allowed for this purpose. Respondents allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
